Visit 5.4 Human Resource Management in our Sustainability Report for more details about our employee support benefits and programmes.

The strategic direction of BTS Group’s CSR initiatives aligns with sustainability-driven priorities from our 3M operations coupled with a clear integration of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Our CSR programmes all work to facilitate community participation and investments through our commercial operations, products, or services. Together, every respective project and initiative work towards a central purpose – to empower communities towards a more sustainable future for all.

To read more about Social and Community Development at BTS Group, explore our Sustainability Report FY2025/26.

Our Strategic Direction for CSR

The Board of Directors and the Sustainability Development Committee have endorsed the strategic direction for the Company’s Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives. Extending beyond climate-related actions, the scope of our CSR activities concurrently supports various community investment initiatives focused on building resilience within the communities we serve towards environmental sustainability and socio-economic development. Coupled with active participation from employees, BTS Group’s CSR initiatives strive to cultivate a safe, inclusive and sustainable quality of life for society.
